test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 20 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: I had to play melody while simultaneously playing harmony with him.
I had to play melody while simultaneously playing harmuny with him.
I had to play melodie while simultaneously playing harmony with him.
I had to play melody while simultanously playing harmony with him.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **I had to play melody while simultaneously playing harmony with him**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"melody"** refers to a sequence of musical notes that are perceived as a single entity; it is the main theme of a piece of music. (मधुर धुन)

 
 
• **Example: **The melody of the song was so catchy that everyone started humming along.
 
 
 
• **"Harmony"** refers to the combination of simultaneously sounded musical notes to produce a pleasing effect. (संगति)
 
 
• **Example: **The choir's voices blended in perfect harmony.
 
 
 
• Only in **option 1**, all the spellings are correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. I had to play melody while simultaneously playing harmony with him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **harmuny** is a misspelling of the word **"harmony."**
 
• **melodie** is a misspelling of the word **"melody."**
 
• **simultanously** is a misspelling of the word **"simultaneously."**
